args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template download page at www.resume-templates.com and the portal at www.resume-templates-portal.com. However, I'm unable to download the PDF files directly due to system restrictions.

The download links I found are:
1. https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf
2. https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf

You can visit these links directly to download the template. Alternatively, you can go to www.resume-templates.com and click on the "Download Links" section.

Let me know if you need any other assistance!

Best regards,
Emma
